primitives.name: Touchdown-to-Goal Sequence
primitives.verbatim_quote: 298 FOOTBALL made the touchdown shall hold the ball for another of his side to kick at some point outside the goal on a line parallel to the side line passing through the point where the touchdown was declared.
primitives.assumptions: Ball must be held and kicked within defined geometric constraints; opponent must remain behind goal line.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When touchdown occurs, transition to kick-off phase begins.

layer2.mapping: Maps touchdown event to geometric placement constraint via parallel line projection onto goal area.
layer2.telemetry: Ball position relative to goal line and sideline alignment

primitives.name: Punt-Out Positioning
primitives.verbatim_quote: (b) If the try-at-goal is to be preceded by a punt-out, the puuter shall kick the ball from the point at which the line parallel to the side-line, and passing through the spot of the touchdown, intersects the goal line.
primitives.assumptions: Kick originates from intersection of parallel line and goal line; players must maintain distance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure to align kick point with geometric constraint invalidates sequence.

layer2.mapping: Derives punt-out starting point from touchdown geometry using line intersection.
layer2.telemetry: Distance between touchdown and punt-out origin

primitives.name: Fair Catch Kick Transition
primitives.verbatim_quote: If a fair catch is made froin a punt-out, the mark shall serve to determine the positions as the mark of any fair catch, and the try-at-goal shall then be made by a place-kick from this spot, or any point directly behind it.
primitives.assumptions: Fair catch defines new kickoff point; kicker must be within bounds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Transition from punt to place-kick upon successful fair catch.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphs fair catch event to place-kick initiation via marker-based positioning.
layer2.telemetry: Positional deviation from fair catch marker
